statement: The rational generalized-Jacobian torus point t=(7,7,1,1,3+zeta3) gives a cubic pro-3 abelian section in the zero toric-minimum fiber which, together with its entire coset modulo three times that fiber group, has no intrinsic class-two, metabelian or marked-depth lift. The zero class in the same fiber lifts fully. The detecting quotient has explicit based G_K action (a,b,c)->(a,b,c+kappa3(zeta3)(g)b).
manuscript_passages: Part E(c),(d), section51.15, scans172-178, (373)-(379); compares the toric minimum with the cubic's intrinsic rank10 quotient.
notes: Actual morphism h=(x+y)/(x+zeta*y) over K=Q(zeta3), with divisors3O-3C2 and sumB_i-3C2. Its rational tangent at O has leading coefficient zeta*lambda^-3. The t-section therefore has total mod3 Kummer pair(zeta,7), retaining the nontrivial affine origin term. At pi=3+zeta of norm7 the local field is Q7, Frobenius/inertia projections are(2,0),(0,1), every pair of Heisenberg-order27 lifts has commutator2C, and exponent3 contradicts the tame relation with exponent7. The geometric map is surjective and its source based Galois action has the displayed nonzero shear. Weil restriction gives an actual global map whose geometric finite image lies in H3xH3. A-structure independently audited the characters, affine origin, local field, Frobenius coefficient and factorization argument. The full intrinsic cubic section classification remains open; this result proves liftability varies within a single already-computed toric fiber.
